text: As part of its vision to become the world’s best provider of sustainable parking, bike share and last mile mobility experiences, Toronto Parking Authority is executing an ambitious rollout plan for Electric Vehicle charging across the City of Toronto. The plan includes the installation of over 500 Electric Vehicle charging stations at Toronto Parking Authority off-street parking locations by the end of 2024 and a minimum of 50 additional on-street public Electric Vehicle charging stations before the end of 2023. The provision of Electric Vehicle charging services is a key component of Toronto Parking Authority’s transformation to a mobility services provider, supports the City of Toronto’s Net Zero Strategy and will support Toronto Parking Authority’s growth and financial returns over the long-term.
